options.content:
**Compare a selection** (BubbleUp-style). Choose **Spans**, the **Y-axis** attribute and a band on it (**From** /
**To**; duration takes units such as `500ms` or `2s`, other attributes plain numbers). Narrow the spans with the **Where**
and **And** filter bars (names and values autocomplete from Tempo; one condition per bar) and split counts with **Group by**.
The heatmap shows the shape, the dot chart every span (click one for its trace). At the bottom, one histogram per attribute:
for each value, the share of the spans **in the band** (orange) next to the share of **everything else** (gray). A value
whose orange bar is much longer than its gray one is what the selection has in common. Drag on the heatmap to narrow the
time range. Traces Drilldown has the same view for a box drawn on a duration heatmap:
[Traces Drilldown](/a/grafana-exploretraces-app/explore) → Duration → select a region → Comparison.

panels.description: TraceQL quantile_over_time(y, 0.9) by the Group by attribute, log scale. Duration is in seconds

panels.title: Every span: ${y:text} over time. Click a dot, then a link, for its trace
panels.description: TraceQL search, one dot per span (up to 1000 traces, 100 spans each: on a busy range not every span is shown, so narrow the time range). Duration is shown in time units. The Tempo panel merges every query into one frame, so spans in the band cannot be coloured separately: use the counts and the table below for the band

targets.query: {${spans} && resource.deployment.environment.name="otel-poc"} | {${where}} | {${and}} | select(${y}, span.ce.page, span.ce.catalog, span.user.id, span.http.route, span.ce.course.key)

panels.title: What the band has in common: backend requests (orange = in the band, gray = everything else)
Most different first: each attribute's values, the attribute with the biggest gap on top
panels.description: BubbleUp: for each attribute, the share of spans in the band (orange) and of everything else (gray) per value. Attributes are ordered by their biggest gap, so the ones that best explain the band come first (top 5 attributes, top 4 values each). Built from TraceQL compare() and a server-side SQL expression

targets.expression:
WITH r AS (SELECT 'Route' AS attr, `span.http.route` AS val, __meta_type AS t, __value__ AS n FROM A WHERE `span.http.route` IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'Page' AS attr, `span.ce.page` AS val, __meta_type AS t, __value__ AS n FROM A WHERE `span.ce.page` IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'Catalog' AS attr, `span.ce.catalog` AS val, __meta_type AS t, __value__ AS n FROM A WHERE `span.ce.catalog` IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'Course' AS attr, `span.ce.course.key` AS val, __meta_type AS t, __value__ AS n FROM A WHERE `span.ce.course.key` IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'Status' AS attr, `span.http.response.status_code` AS val, __meta_type AS t, __value__ AS n FROM A WHERE `span.http.response.status_code` IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'User' AS attr, `span.user.id` AS val, __meta_type AS t, __value__ AS n FROM A WHERE `span.user.id` IS NOT NULL),
tot AS (SELECT attr, t, n AS total FROM r WHERE t IN ('"baseline_total"', '"selection_total"') AND val = '"nil"'),
v AS (SELECT attr, val, SUM(CASE WHEN t = '"selection"' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS sel,
             SUM(CASE WHEN t = '"baseline"' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS base
      FROM r WHERE t IN ('"selection"', '"baseline"') GROUP BY attr, val),
s AS (SELECT v.attr, v.val, v.sel / ts.total AS in_band, v.base / tb.total AS outside FROM v
      JOIN tot ts ON ts.attr = v.attr AND ts.t = '"selection_total"'
      JOIN tot tb ON tb.attr = v.attr AND tb.t = '"baseline_total"'),
score AS (SELECT attr, MAX(ABS(in_band - outside)) AS gap FROM s GROUP BY attr),
ranked AS (SELECT s.attr, s.val, s.in_band, s.outside, score.gap,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score.gap DESC, s.attr) AS attr_rank,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.attr ORDER BY ABS(s.in_band - s.outside) DESC) AS val_rank
           FROM s JOIN score ON score.attr = s.attr)
SELECT CONCAT(attr, ':  ', CASE WHEN val = '"nil"' THEN '(not set)' ELSE REPLACE(val, '"', '') END) AS value,
       in_band AS `in the band`, outside AS `everything else`
FROM ranked WHERE attr_rank <= 5 AND val_rank <= 4
ORDER BY gap DESC, attr, ABS(in_band - outside) DESC
